core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hanafi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “The learned one”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hanafi corresponds to the Arabic form حنفي (Arabic root ح ن ف (ḥ-n-f); حَنَفِي (Ḥanafī)). Its core sense is the learned one; follower of the hanafi school. Hanafi is Arabic حَنَفِي (Ḥanafī), a nisba from the root ح ن ف (ḥ-n-f), and the name of the school of Islamic law founded by Abū Ḥanīfa — a documented historical figure. The source gloss 'the learned one' is a loose rendering; the form is a relational nisba. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave حناڤي with a ڤ (veh) that does not belong in Arabic orthography; the correct form حنفي is given here.

persian.name: حنفی
